
  ▲ vercel project [command]

  Manage your Vercel projects                                                   

  Commands:

  create          name           Create a new project                          
  access-summary  [name]         Show member counts by team role for project   
                                 access (requires access groups entitlement)   
  checks          [name]         List, add, or remove deployment checks for a  
                                 project (GET/POST/DELETE                      
                                 /v2/projects/.../checks)                      
  inspect         [name]         Displays information related to a project     
  list                           Show all projects in the selected scope       
                                 (default)                                     
  members         [name]         List, add, or remove project members for a    
                                 project                                       
  access-groups   [name]         List access groups for a project              
  protection      [name]         Show or toggle deployment protection settings 
                                 for a project                                 
  web-analytics                  Enable or disable Web Analytics for a project 
  speed-insights                 Enable or disable Speed Insights for a project
  pause           [project]      Pause production traffic for a project        
                                 (visitors will see an error page)             
  observability                  Enable or disable Observability Plus for a    
                                 project                                       
  priority                       Upgrade a project to Priority, or remove that 
                                 upgrade                                       
  resume          [project]      Resume production traffic for paused projects 
  update          [name]         Update one or more project settings; omitted  
                                 settings remain unchanged                     
  rename          name new-name  Rename a project                              
  delete          name           Delete a project                              
  token           [name]         Get a development OIDC token for a project    


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Pause production traffic for a project

    $ vercel project pause [NAME]
    $ vercel project pause my-project

  - Resume a paused project

    $ vercel project resume [NAME]
    $ vercel project resume my-project

  - Add a member to a project

    $ vercel project members add [NAME] <EMAIL | UID> --role <ROLE>
    $ vercel project members add my-project user@example.com --role PROJECT_VIEWER

  - Remove a member from a project

    $ vercel project members remove [NAME] <EMAIL | UID>
    $ vercel project members remove my-project user@example.com

  - Enable or disable Observability Plus for a project

    $ vercel project observability enable|disable [NAME]
    $ vercel project observability enable my-project

  - Upgrade a project to Priority

    $ vercel project priority enable|disable [NAME]
    $ vercel project priority enable my-project

  - Enable Web Analytics for a project

    $ vercel project web-analytics [NAME]
    $ vercel project web-analytics my-project

  - Enable Speed Insights for a project

    $ vercel project speed-insights [NAME]
    $ vercel project speed-insights my-project
